title: Evaluating Clinical Competencies of Large Language Models with a General Practice Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, GPBench, measures the clinical competencies of Large Language Models in the context of general medical practice. It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on evaluating clinical medical competencies.
